reason: The README describes a web plugin that tracks per-message token usage, calculates DeepSeek API costs with time-based pricing, and displays usage and cost summaries.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 界面中按会话和时间段统计 DeepSeek token 用量，并计算展示 API 成本。
summaries.en: Tracks DeepSeek token usage by conversation and time period, then calculates and displays API costs in the web interface.

capabilities: Reads per-message token usage and completion timestamps from session projections
Calculates DeepSeek API costs using configured flat and peak/off-peak pricing
Displays conversation, workspace, daily, and five-hour cost summaries in the web interface
